W.note: Very slim collapsed row with a clear step timeline, ETA, tracking number and actions, but the carrier is only a cryptic UP chip and the Carrier page button wraps awkwardly.

X.note: Pleasant green dark styling with progress bar and timeline, but the UPS/USPS/FedEx tabs are confusing for one package and the open card has dead space at the bottom.

Y.note: Richest tracking (stepper, event log, carrier, masked number, copy, refresh, alerts, multi-package dots) in a dense dark card with good ARIA, though the subtitle truncates the ETA.

Z.note: Tightest collapsed state with a segmented progress bar and polished timeline with locations, but no carrier name and only a Dismiss action for what to do next.
